name: GlobeHops
description: Explore air journeys on an interactive globe; shared route estimates and local-time schedules for people and agents.

route.semantics: Up to ten stops; transfer suffix _minutes overrides the default layover. Explicit empty route clears the route.

depN/arrN.semantics: Airport-local wall time at 1-based stop N. Optional :00 seconds. Date-only links are accepted as incomplete; documents require a time. Arrival at origin and departure at destination are ignored.

t.format: ISO instant with Z or offset
t.semantics: Simulation clock instant, independent of airport-local input times.

play.semantics: Start playback on open; reduced motion prevents autoplay.

speed.semantics: Simulation seconds per real second; auto covers the journey in about 15 seconds.

clock.semantics: Timeline display zone; airport code must belong to the route.

itinerary.semantics: ItineraryDocument v1 overrides readable parameters; structural schema linked below.

airportIdentifiers.semantics: Case-insensitive resolution; unknown codes are reported and skipped. Idents containing hyphens use numeric IDs in readable routes; the document syntax accepts 4–8 alphanumeric idents.

timeFormats.offsets: An offset disambiguates airport-local time; it must match the zone at that wall time. Z means local UTC+0, not conversion from UTC.
timeFormats.rules: Runtime Intl IANA rules; DST gaps error, ambiguous times warn and choose earlier unless offset supplied.

estimationModel.notes: Great circle on a sphere; no winds, airline schedules, aircraft type or actual flight tracking. Altitude is illustrative.

validation.valid: No error issues; warnings and info preserve validity. Structural validation precedes semantic resolution. Tolerant readable links keep usable values.

issues.meaning: A date was supplied without a time.
No zone mapped for this airport.
Runtime Intl does not support the mapped zone.
Repeated hour; earlier instant used unless an offset selects one.
Local time falls in a daylight-saving gap.
Explicit offset is invalid at this airport wall time.
Arrival at origin or departure at destination is ignored.
Arrival must follow departure for a nonzero flight.
Entered duration differs substantially from the estimate.
Future times use current runtime time-zone rules.

agentIssues.meaning: Readable route syntax or limits invalid.
assumeDeparture is not an ISO instant.
Undated timeline needs an explicit anchor.
Sample count or instant array exceeds bounds.

versioning: Additive compatible changes retain v1. Breaking changes require document version 2 and a v2 link parameter/version contract; existing v1 links remain readable.

dataset.airports: OurAirports, public domain; checked daily, freshness is recorded rather than guaranteed.
dataset.timeZones: timezone-boundary-builder 2026f, derived from OpenStreetMap; ODbL-1.0. Separate derivative database at src/data/generated/timezones.json.

mcp.prerequisites: Node >=22.18; npm ci in the checkout.

licences.earth: NASA public-use imagery; attribution in project notices
